# Contributing to taskie

Thanks for helping. taskie is developed with taskie, so issues and pull
requests here follow its lifecycle.

## Issues

Open an issue with the bug or feature template. Fill in the sections you can
and leave the rest; triage (`/taskie:new`) adds the type, priority, scope,
edge cases and acceptance criteria. An issue is ready to work on once it is
labelled `ready`.

Report security problems privately, as [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) describes.

## Pull requests

Work on an issue labelled `ready`, on a branch named `issue-<n>-<slug>`, and
open the pull request against `main` with the pull request template. Every
commit passes `just verify`, and a change to what the plugin does bumps its
version. [.claude/CLAUDE.md](../.claude/CLAUDE.md) explains how to work in
this repo, and [docs/design.md](../docs/design.md) explains the design.

Everyone taking part follows the [code of conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
